decision: Modular monolith is the default deployment architecture
acceptance: services/api public module boundaries; no F-ID microservices

decision: Next.js app layer is transport/composition, not a second domain layer
acceptance: route handlers call governed domain contracts

decision: PostgreSQL is authoritative transactional truth
acceptance: search/read models/mobile caches/AI retrieval remain derived

decision: Tenant RLS context is established inside a request-scoped transaction on one checked-out client
acceptance: BEGIN -> tenant context -> queries -> audit/outbox -> COMMIT/ROLLBACK

decision: Server authorization plus RLS defense-in-depth is mandatory
acceptance: org/entitlement/company/branch/record/field scope cannot rely on UI

decision: Every module owns private tables and domain state
acceptance: cross-module access is public command/query/event only

decision: Multi-module coordination lives in services/api/src/orchestration
acceptance: no private-table cross-module mutation

decision: Authoritative money uses decimal-safe PostgreSQL NUMERIC and exact serialization
acceptance: no JS binary floating point or raw BigInt JSON authority

decision: Inventory/payroll/tax/accounting/payment/state legality remains deterministic
acceptance: AI can assist but cannot become system of record

decision: Concurrency-sensitive invariants require DB-safe locking/version/constraint strategy
acceptance: last-unit, posting, approval, close and duplicate races are explicit

decision: Retry-sensitive commands require stable idempotency/business keys
acceptance: duplicate callback/import/job/request effects are prevented/reconciled

decision: Audit and outbox are transactionally coupled to authoritative mutations where required
acceptance: committed truth has durable evidence and async trigger

decision: Posted/consumed truth is reversed/corrected, not silently rewritten
acceptance: ledger/stock/payroll/payment histories preserve evidence

decision: Worker trust scope comes from authenticated/persisted queue metadata, never untrusted payload tenant IDs
acceptance: service-role boundary is explicit and testable

decision: Async handlers declare idempotency, bounded retry/backoff, DLQ/exception and reconciliation
acceptance: no invisible infinite retry or silent loss

decision: Commands and queries are explicit public contracts with typed inputs/errors
acceptance: transport does not duplicate business rules

decision: Externally consumed APIs are versioned and replay/resource bounded
acceptance: webhooks/signatures/correlation/pagination/error codes are standardized

decision: Experience Kernel is the mandatory reusable UX foundation
acceptance: reusable shell/grid/form/record/approval/audit/dashboard patterns

decision: Every major UI surface implements standard operational states
acceptance: loading/empty/error/forbidden/stale/conflict/pending/offline/retry

decision: WCAG 2.2 AA intent and responsive critical-action parity are architecture requirements
acceptance: keyboard/screen-reader/reflow/non-drag alternatives are designed in

decision: Mobile capability is classified; native parity is not automatic
acceptance: FULL/FIELD_OPTIMIZED/APPROVAL_ONLY/READ_ONLY/NOT_APPLICABLE

decision: Offline is opt-in with encrypted bounded state, server revalidation and conflict handling
acceptance: offline never bypasses authorization or deterministic truth

decision: Search/reporting/analytics are permission-scoped derived projections
acceptance: same row/field visibility as direct records; freshness is visible

decision: Observability is part of every capability definition
acceptance: logs/metrics/traces/correlation/jobs/business diagnostics/reconciliation

decision: Security threat modelling and negative authorization tests are mandatory
acceptance: tenant escape/IDOR/PII/worker/webhook/payment/file/AI threats

decision: Backups/PITR/restore/DR and rollback are tested release capabilities
acceptance: document existence alone is not DR evidence

decision: Schema changes use forward-safe migration/expand-migrate-contract discipline
acceptance: deployment compatibility and rollback/restore are planned

decision: AI product runtime retrieves only authorized context with provenance/freshness
acceptance: cross-tenant or hidden-field context is prohibited

decision: AI never directly mutates ERP business tables
acceptance: AI actions execute normal public commands with all policy checks

decision: High-impact AI automation requires explicit policy/approval and kill-switch
acceptance: money/stock/payroll/tax/payment/access changes cannot be silently autonomous

decision: AI engineering agents must follow the 15-step implementation protocol
acceptance: repo audit -> manifest -> DB/domain/API/UI/tests/adversarial/evidence

decision: New frameworks/databases/brokers/ORMs/design systems require an ADR
acceptance: no convenience-driven architecture drift

decision: Implementation follows dependency-aware waves T00-T15, not F001-F510 order
acceptance: platform and deterministic primitives precede dependent modules

decision: Release environments are local/CI/development/staging/production with gated promotion
acceptance: staging mirrors critical auth/tenant/worker/integration behavior

decision: Feature readiness requires evidence across data/backend/auth/UI/tests/integration/UAT
acceptance: route/table/button/test-stub existence is never completion

decision: F001-F510 and SP001-SP036 remain planning authority; implementation cannot invent scope
acceptance: planning conflict is a stop condition and change-control event
